unsloth-qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct-ggu.label: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B published config
unsloth-qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct-ggu.note: 30.5B-parameter MoE (3.3B active). All experts stay resident, so weights are the full GGUF file size; only attention layers hold KV cache.

unsloth-qwen3-6-27b-gguf.label: Qwen3.6-27B published config
unsloth-qwen3-6-27b-gguf.note: Hybrid model: only the 16 full-attention layers (of 64) grow a KV cache. The Gated DeltaNet layers keep a small fixed-size state that this estimate does not include.

unsloth-devstral-small-2507-gguf.label: Devstral Small 2507 published config
unsloth-devstral-small-2507-gguf.note: Dense 24B model with standard grouped-query attention.

unsloth-gpt-oss-20b-gguf.label: gpt-oss-20b published config
unsloth-gpt-oss-20b-gguf.note: 21B-parameter MoE (3.6B active). Half the layers use a 128-token sliding window, so their KV cache stops growing past 128 tokens.

bartowski-google-gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-gguf.label: Gemma 4 26B-A4B published config
bartowski-google-gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-gguf.note: 25.2B-parameter MoE (~3.8B active). 25 sliding-window layers (1024 tokens) plus 5 global layers. Global layers may share K and V; this estimate stores both, so it errs high.
